_comment: Per-file time.Sleep budget baseline (#1565). Extends the #1550 count ratchet (scripts/verify/test-sleep-baseline.json) with value budgets: count, total_ms (sum of all resolved sleeps), max_ms (largest single sleep) and the exact per-sleep values, so a 20ms sleep cannot silently become 20s and the lane wall-clock cannot grow unapproved. Any count/value increase requires -UpdateBaseline (tracked approval). kinds: poll_deadline (interval inside a deadline-guarded loop), negative_window (assert 'did not happen'), simulated_slow (handler/mock/loader slow behavior), real_protocol (real heartbeat/debounce/subprocess time), grace_window (async callback/drain grace). owner/review required per file. Gate (#1948): verify-test-sleep-ratchet.py enforces this file — it must exist, every budgeted path must exist on disk, and count/total_ms/max_ms plus the exact per-sleep values must match the source; unresolvable (non-constant) sleep expressions and files with sleeps but no entry fail closed.

edge-server/internal/adapters/acp/acp_cl.reason: waitForEvent / waitForBrokerPending poll intervals; every loop is deadline-guarded (1-5s) and dumps state on timeout (#1550).

edge-server/internal/adapters/claude/cla.reason: Simulated slow ACP server response in mock handler; channel barrier not applicable (server must appear slow to client).

edge-server/internal/adapters/codex/code.reason: Simulated slow ACP server response in mock handler.

edge-server/internal/adapters/opencode/o.reason: Simulated slow ACP server response in mock handler.

edge-server/internal/adapters/orchestrat.reason: Simulated slow async approval in goroutines (approval arrives after the request); ordering needs real scheduling, not a barrier.

edge-server/internal/events/bus_behavior.reason: 20ms negative window (observer must NOT fire after cancel; channel cannot assert absence); 1ms poll inside select with 1s deadline; 3ms simulated concurrent add/remove pacing; 100ms backpressure drain grace; 5ms activity window for unsubscribe-while-publishing; 200ms async observer worker grace.

edge-server/internal/events/bus_test.go.reason: Simulated slow subscribe/unsubscribe and publish pacing inside concurrent goroutines to force interleavings; bounded by wg.Wait().

edge-server/internal/httpserver/server_t.reason: Grace window after <-started to let the handler goroutine observe shutdown; started channel proves launch, sleep covers scheduling.

edge-server/internal/hub/hub_behavior_te.reason: Simulated slow callback server: sleeps longer than the client context deadline to prove the client errors on deadline (client hardcodes 30s; no clock seam yet).

edge-server/internal/lifecycle/decision_.reason: Simulated slow async approval in goroutine so the loop observes the decision after a scheduling gap.

edge-server/internal/lifecycle/process_e.reason: Poll interval for max concurrent callbacks; loop is deadline-guarded (500ms) with loud failure.

80ms negative window proving child stays alive after Cancel (did-not-happen assertion, kept bounded); 10ms cancel-race goroutine pacing (simulated slow); 5000ms helper-subprocess 'sleep' mode (real subprocess protocol time, killed by executor). The three former deadline-guarded poll intervals (10ms x2, 20ms) were converted to testkit.Eventually (approved 2026-08-29, #2038).

edge-server/internal/skills/skills_test..reason: waitForDebounce waits hotReloadDebounce (500ms const) + 500ms margin (approved 2026-08-29, #2033: bounded negative-window assertion needs headroom on busy runners): real debounce protocol time, clock seam pending in skill_watch; 50ms write pacing so coalescing can fold 5 writes.

edge-server/tests/hub_e2e_test.go.reason: E2E lane (short-skipped in CI): 500ms x3 async callback grace windows (callbacks fire from a goroutine after the run reaches a terminal status; kept bounded); 2000ms real run completion (subprocess protocol time doubling as the negative window proving no callback fires without hubTaskId). The three former deadline-guarded run-status poll intervals (100/100/200ms) were converted to testkit.Eventually (approved 2026-08-29, #2055).

hub-server/internal/app/background_test..reason: 100ms simulated slow cleanup so Shutdown must wait; 20ms shutdown grace window.

hub-server/internal/bus/bus_test.go.reason: Poll interval for drainBus; loop is deadline-guarded (3s) with failure.

hub-server/internal/bus/publish_close_st.reason: Publish/Close stress characterization (#2071 S1, benign): 50us simulated slow handler, 50ms pre-round settle, 20ms post-drain before pending assert. Bounded rounds (5x3s), deadline-guarded.

hub-server/internal/cache/client_test.go.reason: Simulated slow loader inside singleflight (100ms keeps sf.Do open for joiners; 50ms in 30-goroutine contention test). Barrier already used; loader must stay slow to prove single-flight.

hub-server/internal/middleware/rate_limi.reason: Waits for real 100ms rate-limit window expiry; rate limiter has no injectable clock yet (clock seam pending).

hub-server/internal/middleware/timeout_t.reason: Simulated slow handlers: 5s handler vs 100ms middleware timeout (test returns fast via timeout), 200ms concurrent-write handler, 5s handler in panic-prevention test. Handler must outlast the timeout; no clock seam in Timeout middleware.

hub-server/internal/service/agent/run_ev.reason: TestStartRunEventRetentionLoop_CancelStops: 200ms startup-pass grace + 100ms post-cancel drain grace; loop test only, no per-iteration sleeps (#2070 retention loop wiring).

hub-server/internal/service/audit/reliab.reason: Poll interval for audit failure counter; loop is deadline-guarded (2s).

hub-server/internal/ws/heartbeat_cancel_.reason: 5ms poll interval (2s deadline) for heartbeat ticks; 30ms+60ms negative windows proving no further ticks after cancel (heartbeat uses real ticker; no injectable clock yet).

hub-server/tests/integration/ws_reconnec.reason: Integration lane: 10ms deadline-guarded poll (2s), 350ms real heartbeat-interval wait (3 intervals must elapse to prove heartbeat keeps the connection), 50ms drain grace.
